summary: Orphaned rate adjustment applied to tenant invoice causing negative line and provisional credit request
description:
Issue summary:
BrightPath Analytics received their monthly invoice (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31) with an unexpected negative line item named 'rate_adjustment_orphan' (-$1,198.45). The charge is labeled as an 'adjustment' but appears to have no matching postback or reconciliation record.

Impact:
- Customer-facing: BrightPath is refusing autopay until the invoice is corrected.
- Financial: Negative line causes final invoice to show a provisional credit; impacts revenue reporting and may be interpreted as duplicated credit.
- Operational: Customer is enterprise tier with Dedicated capacity; urgent to avoid SLA breach and churn.

Environment:
- Prod billing pipeline (postback-reconciler v2.4.1) processing region us-east-1.
- Customer uses dedicated capacity with tenant tag tenant: brightpath-prod.

Observed behavior:
- Invoice 2026-03 produced an extra negative line 'rate_adjustment_orphan' (-$1,198.45).
- No associated postback id, no matched usage window in hourly-accumulator.
- Billing UI displays source 'auto-recon', but the recon job logs do not contain a matching reconciliation run.

Expected behavior:
- Adjustments should always link to a reconciliation event or manual credit memo with author and rationale.

Additional context:
- Customer reports they did not request credits and have not disputed prior invoices.
- BrightPath provided the invoice PDF and CSV export (attached by customer in portal).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Query invoice lines for invoice ID INV-2026-03-BR-0042 via billing-api /v1/invoices/{id}/lines
2) Cross-reference postback-reconciler logs for timeframe 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-02T04:00:00Z
3) Query hourly-accumulator for tenant brightpath-prod for same windows for any retroactive adjustments
4) Inspect billing UI audit trail for 'auto-recon' job invocation and linked reconciliation id
logs:
Sample reconciler log snippet (2026-03-02T01:14:23Z): [INFO] auto-recon started run=run_20260302_01 tenant=brightpath-prod
[WARN] postback not found for candidate adjustment id=adj_7f8a3 - skipping link
[INFO] auto-recon completed run=run_20260302_01 adjustments_applied=1
Billing API query (2026-03-02T01:15:01Z) returned line: {"line_id":"line_98312","description":"rate_adjustment_orphan","amount":-1198.45,"source":"auto-recon","linked_postback":null}
investigation_notes: 03-12 10:22 - Support triaged; confirmed invoice PDF and negative line present.
03-12 11:05 - Billing team queried postback table (postbacks_2026_03): no postback with id adj_7f8a3 or equivalent found.

03-12 13:40 - Noted auto-recon run reported adjustments_applied=1; reconciler log includes a WARN 'postback not found' for adj_7f8a3. Hypothesis: reconciler applied adjustment record with missing linkage when postback lookup failed but fallback path created adjustment without provenance.

03-13 09:12 - Looked at deploy history: postback-reconciler v2.4.1 was rolled 2026-03-02 00:50 with config change 'allow-orphan-adjustments=true' toggled in feature flags for a hotfix. That flag may be responsible.

03-13 14:00 - Cross-checked git history: PR #5421 introduced allow-orphan-adjustments to avoid blocking large reconciles; intent was to create provisional adjustment records tagged provisional=true and with owner 'system-recon'. The created records should include original_run_id and candidate_postback_id; current record has null fields.
resolution:
Temporary workaround: Applied manual credit memo CM-2026-03-BP-01 for $1,198.45 to negate the orphaned adjustment and reissued invoice draft. Finance applied a hold release to allow autopay once customer confirms.
Planned fix: Revert feature-flag 'allow-orphan-adjustments' for reconciler in us-east, add stricter validation to avoid creating adjustments with null provenance, and run a targeted rescan for reconciler runs 2026-03-02 to identify other orphaned adjustments.
Owner: Billing engineering (assignee: Ravi Patel). ETA for patch and rescan: 2026-03-17.
comments: 2026-03-12 10:30 - Jenna Alvarez (Support): Opened with BrightPath; customer attached invoice PDF. Customer requests immediate correction and confirmation that autopay will not charge incorrectly.
2026-03-12 11:10 - Ravi Patel (Billing Eng): Acknowledged; assigned to me for triage. Beginning log sweep and reconciler checks.

2026-03-13 09:20 - Billing Eng (Ravi Patel): Found the feature flag toggle and suspect reconciler created an adjustment stub. Escalating to engineering oncall for rollback approval. Linked PR #5421 for context.
2026-03-13 15:05 - Finance (Marta Klein): Applied provisional credit memo CM-2026-03-BP-01. Notified customer and placed invoice hold until customer confirmation.

2026-03-14 08:45 - Customer (Elena Morris, BrightPath): Thanks — we see the provisional credit on the portal. Please confirm the underlying cause and when fix will be deployed; need written confirmation for our internal auditors.
2026-03-14 09:05 - Jenna Alvarez (Support): Confirmed we'll provide a postmortem and root cause once engineering finishes the rescan and patch. ETA 2026-03-17.
